items.title: Pay overdue February 2026 invoice plus reminder fee (2nd dunning)
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie, den offenen Betrag (Zahlungseingang bis 07.04.2026) auszugleichen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for when payment must have arrived: 07.04.2026. This is an explicit deadline printed by the sender, not a period to be counted from delivery. 2026-04-07 is a Tuesday, not a weekend or public holiday in NW, so no shift applies. Due date = 2026-04-07 (payment must be received by then, per 'Zahlungseingang bis').

warnings: This is a second dunning (2. Mahnung) from a private company (NetzMuster GmbH), not a court or public authority, so no statutory legal-remedy instruction or deemed-delivery rule applies; the payment date is simply the date the company itself set.
The letter threatens to suspend/block the connection ('Sperre Ihres Anschlusses') for further payment delay if the amount is not settled by 07.04.2026.

The IBAN DE71 3705 0198 0001 2312 31 is a valid, well-formed German IBAN (Musterbank AG, BLZ 37050198), but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; verify it matches previous invoices/dunning letters from this provider before paying.
